title: UnlockFlowEvent
description: Scout-approved Capital Flow Desk Agent Feed event v1. Supply-shock unlock window framed as capital-flow judgment for bots/MCPs/trading AIs. Research framing only — not trade signals. NFA.

event_id.description: Stable unique id for this unlock×flow judgment event (e.g. uf_YYYYMMDD_asset_horizon).

chain.description: Primary settlement / vesting chain (e.g. ethereum, solana, bsc).

contract_address.description: Optional token contract address when known and relevant.

unlock_ts.description: ISO-8601 unlock / cliff timestamp (prefer Asia/Dubai offset when desk-local).

horizon.description: Relative window for this judgment pass.

observed_at.description: When this event payload was assembled / last refreshed.

update_freq.description: Expected refresh cadence for this horizon (e.g. daily, twice_daily, on_publish).

value_usd.description: Notional unlock size in USD at observation pricing.

amount_tokens.description: Token amount unlocking in this event / window.

pct_circulating.description: Unlock as percent of circulating supply at observe time.

vtmc.description: Unlock value as percent of (or ratio vs) fully diluted / relevant market cap framing — desk uses value-to-market-cap style %.

float_depth_usd.description: Optional estimated liquid float / book depth USD near spot for pressure context.

vesting_type.description: Dominant vesting mechanic for this unlock.

precision_grade.description: How precise the size / schedule fields are vs public disclosure.

sell_pressure_score.description: Editorial 0–100 sell-pressure judgment from size + recipient behavior + venue context. Not a trade signal.

confidence.description: Editorial confidence in the flow judgment, not trade confidence.

cex_inflow_z.description: Optional z-score of recent CEX inflow vs baseline for labeled / inferred recipients.

recipient_to_cex.description: Optional whether material recipient wallets show CEX deposit behavior in the window.

pre_event_drift_note.description: Short note on price/flow drift into the unlock window.

invalidation.description: What would falsify or retire this sell-pressure framing.

human_memo_ref.description: Optional path/id of the human markdown memo / VIP window note.

disclaimer.description: Fixed short disclaimer token; expand in consumer UI as Not Financial Advice.

webhook_topic.description: Pro webhook topic name for this schema.

illustrative.description: If true, payload is a sample / illustrative only — do not treat as live desk output.

bucket.description: e.g. team, investor, ecosystem, foundation, community, advisor, other

vesting_type.description: Optional override when bucket vesting differs from event-level vesting_type.

examples.pre_event_drift_note: Spot lagged majors 3d into window; labeled investor cohort showed elevated CEX deposit z vs 30d baseline while OI rose without matching spot bid.
examples.invalidation: Cohort wallets idle on-chain through T0 with CEX inflow z reverting below 0.5 and unlock notional revised below 1% circulating on primary disclosure.
evidence: Unlock notional ~$185M (~2.4% circ) at observe pricing
Investor bucket majority of event; historical same-cohort deposits preceded prior unlocks
Peer-venue USDT/USDC float flat — pressure is token-specific, not aggregate stable expansion
